summary.intent: Review 13 open todos (items #5–17) and organize them into coherent phases to append to the current milestone (M3/v1.1), then reopen M3, backfill the ROADMAP progress table, commit, and open a PR.
summary.outcome: M3 (v1.1) reopened with 6 new hardening phases (50–55) absorbing 10 todos; ROADMAP progress table backfilled for phases 40–55; todos #7 and #8 correctly moved to completed (already delivered by Phase 49); changes committed on branch docs/reopen-m3-hardening-phases and pushed for PR.

repo: M3 = v1.1 (phases 18–49, previously marked complete 2026-06-18); M4 = v2.0 Encrypted Productivity Suite is already defined with its own dir — inserting a v1.2 milestone between them was ruled out in favor of reopening M3.
REQUIREMENTS.md already had a 'v1.2 Requirements' section, but it covers future features (CRDT shares, DB minimization, BYO-direct), not hardening — new HARD-01…06 requirement IDs were needed.
ROADMAP Progress table was stale: it stopped tracking after Phase 39, and rows for phases 38/39 were incorrectly marked 'Planned' despite being 4/4 Complete.
Todos #7 (useFolderNavigation key-unwrap consolidation) and #8 (shared-move re-encrypt) were stale-pending — Phase 49 had already delivered both, confirmed in live code.
gsd-tools has no `milestone reopen` command; reopening requires manual edits to STATE.md frontmatter and multiple ROADMAP sections.
`phase add-batch` only appends Phase Detail blocks to ROADMAP (before the last `---`) and creates phase dirs — it does not touch the checklist bullets, Progress table, Milestones range, or STATE.md.
Todo #10 (gsd-tools `phase complete` regresses STATE.md) is GSD's own tooling bug, not CipherBox product code — excluded from product milestone phases and routed as upstream chore.
4 older feature todos (#1 ERC-1271, #2 CRDT inbox, #3 async search, #4 MFA factors) remain unscheduled and were not grouped into phases.

code.finding: Todo #7 already resolved: now delegates to client.ensureFolderLoaded instead of duplicating key-unwrap logic inline — Phase 49 delivered this.
Todo #8 already resolved: moveInSharedFolder with re-key-to-destination logic exists, along with shared-folder-move.spec.ts — Phase 49 delivered this.

workflow: Always verify live code before treating a stale-pending todo as open — ROADMAP/STATE history and todo files can fall out of sync with what was actually shipped.

When reopening a completed milestone, the safer pattern is to fan out parallel read-only agents to digest todos by theme before synthesizing phase groups — keeps main context clean for the structural decisions.

gsd-tools `progress --raw` shows 100% plan-completion even immediately after a milestone reopen because new phases have no plans yet; this is distinct from the phase-based percent in STATE.md frontmatter — both figures are correct and consistent.

friction: A `cd` in an earlier Bash tool call persisted the shell working directory into subsequent calls, causing 'file not found' errors when reading ROADMAP/STATE from what was expected to be the repo root.

No `milestone reopen` command in gsd-tools — required careful manual edits across STATE.md frontmatter, ROADMAP Overview, Milestones line, Phases checklist, Progress table, and Phase Details sections with no single sanctioned codepath.
ROADMAP Progress table had 16 phases of drift (40–55 missing, 38/39 incorrect status) that had to be backfilled using per-phase plan-file counts scraped from disk.
Two todos (#7, #8) were stale-pending despite being delivered by Phase 49 — required a code verification pass mid-flight before the phase grouping could be finalized.

Todo #10 (gsd-tools `phase complete` regresses STATE.md on a milestone's final phase) is a known upstream GSD tooling bug — routed as an upstream chore, not tracked in the CipherBox milestone.
